title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up evaluation for management of chronic conditions.

HPI
The patient is a known case of type 2 diabetes mellitus and presents for routine follow-up. The patient reports adherence to dietary guidelines for managing his type 2 diabetes. He states he is working on maintaining a diet controlled approach with his primary care provider. He also reports continued management of his chronic kidney disease stage 4 through lifestyle modifications, including diet and exercise. He denies any acute complaints since the last visit.

Medication List
None at this time.

Exam
Vitals are stable and within acceptable limits for the patient’s history. Physical exam is generally unremarkable.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus: Managed with diet and exercise.
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4: Management remains focused on diet controlled strategies.

Plan
Continue current management plan. Emphasis remains on consistent adherence to a diet controlled regimen for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Patient encouraged to continue diet and exercise program for CKD stage 4. Follow up as scheduled.
explanations: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes in the Index, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E11.22.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.

distractors.why: The provider does not have to write 'due to'; 'with' presumes the link.
E11.2 is a subcategory; a 5th character is required.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
